aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Return Cycle Time (Days to Return)
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  courier_partner,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS avg_days_to_return,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS min_days,
  MAX(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS max_days
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
  AND delivered_date IS NOT NULL
  AND return_created_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY courier_partner;
